novel_query.answer:
dictionary An associative array, where arbitrary keys are mapped to values. [1]

Another useful data type built into Python is the dictionary (see Mapping Types — dict ). [2]

It is best to think of a dictionary as a set of key: value pairs, with the requirement that the keys are unique (within one dictionary). [3]

If keyword arguments are specified, the dictionary is then updated with those key/value pairs: d.update(red=1, blue=2) . [4]
